title: Orbit Playback
description: Consumption history and resume-progress for video, audio, article (novel), and manga plugins.

playbackMode.description: Progress semantics. Omit to default from manifest mediaType: video→video, audio→audio, article→article, manga→manga

history.description: Whether to record consumption history (parent work + last chapter/episode)

progress.description: Whether to record resume position within a chapter/episode (semantics depend on mode)

mode.description: Progress field semantics; defaults from mediaType when omitted

limit.description: Max history entries retained per plugin; oldest pruned when exceeded

managedBy.description: runtime: client persists on reader/player events; plugin: WASM handles playback_* actions

playbackFeature.description: Optional per-channel override; omitted fields inherit config.playback

progressTime.description: video / audio: resume by playback time (seconds)

duration.description: Total duration in seconds when known

progressArticle.description: article / novel: resume by character offset in chapter text

offset.description: 0-based character index in chapter plain text

total.description: Total characters in chapter when known

anchor.description: Optional paragraph id or DOM fragment for rich-text resume

progressManga.description: manga: resume by image/page index within a chapter

page.description: 1-based image index in chapter (第几张图)

totalPages.description: Total images in chapter when known

chapterId.description: Chapter / episode / 话 id for serial content

mode.description: Progress semantics for this record; should match config.playback.mode

progress.description: Mode-specific resume payload; shape depends on mode

position.description: Deprecated shorthand for progress.position when mode is video or audio

duration.description: Deprecated shorthand for progress.duration when mode is video or audio
